'''Roger Gardner''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver DPC invitational]] on 2 September 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ Classic]], according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2973">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-co-invitational-a-swccg-nerd-ii-9-2-01d2973/ co-invitational-a-swccg-nerd-ii-9-2-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 17 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-co-invitational-a-swccg-nerd-ii-9-2-01d2973/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
